messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: Hey! I am looking to make some Hot Potato Books to enhance some of my weapons, do you have any potatoes to spare?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 嘿! 我想做些 Hot Potato Book 强化武器,你有多余的土豆吗?

messages.text: Thanks man! I'll be sure to smear these potatoes all over my weapons, that'll sure improve 'em!
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 谢了兄弟! 我一定把这些土豆全抹在武器上,肯定能让它们变强!

messages.text: Too bad, I guess I'll have to look for actual metal next time...
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 太可惜了,看来下次我得去找真正的金属……
